title: A gentle wave in the paper forest

clips.label: Forest — original motion
clips.note: Library → paper trees → traveler and distant city
clips.details:
Three-second ending excerpt. The main approach and turn continue as the library becomes a forest. The final lone figure provides a readable focal point, though the change from several people to one is abrupt.

Krea Turbo recurrent feedback, CFG1, three Euler intervals. Time-based Lanczos warps. RIFE 4.25 scale 1, 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second. All paintings are preserved.

clips.label: Forest — added wave
clips.note: Same paintings up to the branch, then one extra spatial wave
clips.details:
Adds one bounded horizontal wave to the existing movement, with the same prompt, noise and seeds. The new paintings react to that altered geometry. The ending is more abstract, and the figure becomes a dark flowing shape. A wave in recurrent generation changes more than the final playback motion.

Krea Turbo recurrent feedback, CFG1, three Euler intervals. Time-based Lanczos warps. RIFE 4.25 scale 1, 24 fps, three paintings per displayed second. All paintings are preserved.
